project.name: VialTrack AI
project.oneLiner: Physical inventory for a compounding pharmacy fridge, built for phones and an iMac label station.
project.goal: VialTrack keeps a live count of the compounded vials in the pharmacy fridge. Every shelf, bin and 25-vial tray gets a QR label; staff count with a phone by scanning and tapping, with optional AI photo counting. It remembers each tray's lot number and beyond-use date so it always shows which tray to use first, and every count updates stock, is logged, and can be pulled as a spreadsheet or over an API.

deploy.plain: Merging to main builds the app and deploys it to Google Cloud Run automatically (GitHub Actions). Nothing is deployed from AI Studio any more.
